Chernihiv Regional Historical Museum named after V.V. Tarnovsky (Ukrainian: Чернігівський обласний історичний музей) is one of the oldest and most famous museums in Ukraine. The museum is located in the former governor's house IN Chernihiv (XIX century).
History
The museum was founded on 14 November 14 1896 as the Chernihiv Regional Scientific Archival Commission and its Historical Museum.
In 1902, the Museum of Ukrainian Antiquities named after V.V. Tarnovsky was founded based on the collection of Vasyl Tarnovsky Jr. In 1923, five museums of Chernihiv were united in the Chernihiv State Museum.
In 1997, the museum was renamed "Chernihiv Regional Historical Museum named after V.V. Tarnovsky".
On March 6, 2022, during the Siege of Chernihiv, the main building of the museum was damaged, where it sheltered residents during the siege.
